# The Arch packages CI installs to configure, build and test every library.
# One package per line. A comment after `#` is ignored.

git
ccache
cmake
ninja
extra-cmake-modules
qt6-base
qt6-declarative
qt6-shadertools
qt6-svg
qt6-wayland
wayland
wayland-protocols
# Qt declares QVulkanInstance only when the Vulkan headers are present, and
# phosphor-surfaces uses it wherever Qt was built with Vulkan, as Arch's is.
vulkan-headers
# Optional lookups, installed so CI builds the code they switch on:
# KGlobalAccel (phosphor-shortcuts) and Kirigami (phosphor-control's tests).
kglobalaccel
kirigami
# The offscreen and Wayland tests' runtime.
mesa
